title: 2013 Panini Score Football Alex Okafor #336 Rookie RC - Arizona Cardinals

descriptionText: This 2013 Panini Score Football card features Alex Okafor, a rookie player from the Arizona Cardinals. The card number is 336 and it is a single product from the 2013 Score set. It is a standard size sports trading card, perfect for any NFL fan's collection. The card is not autographed and is part of the modern era of football trading cards. The manufacturer is SCORE and the card is categorized under Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop and Sports Trading Cards, Trading Card Singles.
